english.title: Import fireworks without giving information to Customs and Excise - Firework Reg's 2004
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) imported fireworks, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AMOUNT AND DESCRIPTION..) without having first provided your name and address, the name and address of the person who is to store the fireworks and, the address of the premises at which the fireworks are to be stored, to the Commissioners of Customs and Excise
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 11 of the Fireworks Regulations 2004 and section 11(2) and (4) of the Fireworks Act 2003.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months (see regulation 13 of the Fireworks Regulations 2004)

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
